entities.name: PMID:25089253
observations: Successive exposure to moderate hypoxia does not affect glucose metabolism and substrate oxidation in young healthy men.

entities.name: No metabolic effect of 7-h hypoxia
observations: In a crossover study of eight healthy men, 7 h at FiO₂ 15.0% did not significantly alter postprandial glucose or insulin responses, their 7-h areas under the curve, or average respiratory exchange ratio versus normoxia; sample size was small.
